notes: Corrected: the italicized *the righteousness* at t012-t013 was assigned to πλεῖον. No part of a comparative quantifier is realized by a repeated noun, and rule 103 governs a repeated lexical noun whose source token is already spent — δικαιοσύνη stands at t009 — so the pair is added, headed on the nominal, with the supplied determiner inside the unit.
πλεῖον is joined to περισσεύσῃ on the single lexical word exceed under rule 39's test rather than left unrepresented; the note on that unit records the competing reading.
The rest of the verse is unchanged: ἐὰν μή and οὐ μή stand as rule 39 and rule 33 units, and the genitive article is emptied under rule 23.
